title: Kots's Divine Modpack
description: Just my Personal Minecraft Modpack aiming to overhaul dimensions in the game.
body:
This modpack aims to overhaul the dimensions in Minecraft, add _"some"_ beauty to the world and add FPS. Mods that overhaul dimensions are: 

[Better End](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend)

[Better Nether](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether)

I've also installed the YUNG's **xxx structure** overhaul mod collection to the overworld. 

Most mods are **QoL** _(Quality of Life)_ mods and add minor only things.

Due to the nature of the pack, it cannot be played on a server unless the server owner has installed server-side mods of the pack.

The pack features mods that may reduce your FPS like: Distant Horizons & Shaders. This in effect can make it near impossible to play on medium/lower-end PCs.

**I advise playing on a high-end PC, however you can disable Distant Horizons and just use vanilla render distance as well as turn off shaders.**

I recommend playing with Shader settings as much as you can to achieve the result you want as
[Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches) to Complementary are actually something else...
